content: Sang Adam lel Eipraam
Adam me wia semen Sehd, Sehd me wia semen Enos, Enos me wia semen Kenan,
Kenan me wia semen Maalalel, Maalalel me wia semen Sared,
Sared me wia semen Enok, me iei semen Medusala; Medusala iei semen Lamek,
me iei semen Noha. Noha naineki pwutak silimen: Sehm, Ahm, oh Saped.
Nein Saped kan iei—Komer, Makok, Madai, Sapan, Tupal, Mesek, oh Tiras—irail me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Komer iei irail mehn Askenas, Ripahd, oh Tokarma.
Kadaudok en Sapan iei irail mehn Elisa, mehn Spein, Saiprus, oh Rohdes.
Nein Ahm kan iei—Kus, Isip, Lipia, oh Kenan—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Kus iei irail mehn Sepa, Apila, Sapta, Raama, oh Sapteka. Kadaudok en Raama iei mehn Sipa, oh Dedan.
(Kus naineki pwutak emen ede Nimrod, me wiahla sounpei keieu lapalap emen nan sampah.)
Kadaudok en Isip kan iei mehn Lidia, Anam Lehap, Napdu,
Padrus, Kaslu, oh Krihd (me mehn Pilisdia kan pwilisang ie).
Nein Kenan pwutak—Saidon, me keieu laud, oh Ed—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kenan pil wia pahpa kahlep en mehn Sepus, mehn Amor, mehn Kirkas,
mehn Ip, mehn Ark, mehn Sin,
mehn Arpad, mehn Semar oh mehn Amad.
Nein Sehm pwutak—Elam, Ahsur, Arpaksad, Lud, Aram, Us, Ul, Keder, oh Mesek—irail me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Arpaksad me naineki Sela, Sela me naineki Eper.
Eper naineki pwutak riemen: emen adaneki Pelek,
pwehki nindokon eh mwehi aramas en sampah pwalpeseng wiahda pali kei; oh meteio adaneki Sokdan.
Kadaudok en Sokdan kan iei mehn Almodad, Selep, Asarmaped, Sera,
Adoram, Usal, Dikla,
Epal, Apimael, Sipa,
Opir, Apila, oh Sopap.
Iet irekidien peneinei sang Sehm lel Apram: Sehm, Arpaksad, Sela,
Eper, Pelek, Reu,
Seruk, Nahor, Tera,
oh Apram (me pil kin adaneki Eipraam).
Kadaudok en Ismael kan
Eipraam naineki pwutak riemen, Aisek oh Ismael.
Nein Ismael pwutak ko wiahla moangen kadaudok eisek riauo: Nepaiod (tepida sang ni nein Ismael pwutak me keieu laud), Keder, Adpeel, Mipsam,
Misma, Duma, Massa, Adad, Tema,
Setur, Napis, oh Kedema.
Eipraam pil pekehikihda emen lih tohrohr, me adaneki Ketura, e ahpw naitikihong Simram, Soksan, Medan, Midian, Ispak, oh Sua. Soksan naineki pwutak riemen: Sipa oh Dedan.
Midian naineki pwutak limmen: Epa, Eper, Anok, Apida, oh Eldaa.
Kadaudok en Esau kan
Nein Eipraam pwutak Aisek naineki pwutak riemen: Esau oh Seikop.
Nein Esau pwutak kan iei Elipas, Reuel, Seus, Salam, oh Kora.
Elipas wiahla pahpa kahlap en kadaudok en me pahn wad pah kan: Teman, Omar, Sepi, Katam, Kenas, Timna, oh Amalek.
Oh Reuel wiahla pahpa kahlap en kadaudok kan en Nahad, Sera, Samma, oh Mihsa.
Pwilidak en Edom

Pwilidak en Edom tepisang nein Seir pwutak pwukat: Lotan, me pahpa kahlap en peneineien Ori oh Omam. (Mie rien Lotan serepein men adaneki Timna.) Sopal me pahpa kahlap en peneineien Alpan, Manaad, Epal, Sehpi, oh Onam. Sipeon, naineki pwutak riemen, Aiah oh Anah. Anah me semen Dihson, oh Dihson me wia pahpa kahlap en peneineien Amran, Espan, Idran, oh Seran. Eser me pahpa kahlap en peneineien Pilan, Sapan, oh Sakan. Dihsan me pahpa kahlap en peneineien Us oh Aran.
Nanmwarki kan en Edom
Nanmwarki pwukat me kaunda wehin Edom, emenemen mwurin emen, ni ahnsou me saikinte mie nanmwarki nan Israel:
Tohn Edom pwalpeseng wiahda kadaudok pwukat: Timna, Alpa, Seded,
Olipama, Elah, Pinon,
Kenas, Teman, Mipsar, Makdiel, oh Iram.

footnotes.text: PELEK: Sisen lepin mahsen wet ni mahsen en Ipru ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen me wehwehki “Pwalpeseng.”
